t: You're thinking about the Great Exhibition, also called the Crystal Palace Exhibition, which took place in Hyde Park from 1 May to 15 October 1851. Its full title was the Great Exhibition of the Works of Industry of All Nations. It was the first of the world's fairs, those exhibitions of culture and industry that became popular in the nineteenth century. It was organised by Henry Cole and by Prince Albert, Queen Victoria's husband, who is the person most closely tied to making it happen.
